day_local: Sabtida Usbuuca sodon iyo koowaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla joogaan maanta iyo weligiisba.
penitential:

psalm_response: Rabbiga ka cabsada waa barakaysan yahay.
homily:
Bal ka fikir qof haysta buug yar oo ay ku qoran yihiin erayo uu gacantiisa ku qoray, ama koodh ay si taxaddar leh u dhex dhoobeen shaashadda kombuyuutarka. Waa xilli habeen ah, gurigu wuu aamusan yahay, kaliya waxaa dhawaaqaya qaboojiyaha iyo neecawda dibadda ka imanaysa. Wiil yar ayaa fadhiya miiska agtiisa, indhihiisu waa kuwo fiirsasho ka buuxdo, wuxuuna ku riyoonayaa inuu maalin maalmaha ka mid ah abuuro shirkad diyaaradeed oo uu ugu magac daray 'con chim airlines'. Wuxuu dhoola caddaynayaa markuu ka fikirayo sida diyaaraduhu u fuulayaan daruuraha sare. Waa daqiiqad caadi ah, balse waxaa ku dhex jira adduun dhan oo riyooyin, caqli, iyo jacayl ah.

Maanta, markaan akhrineyno warqaddii Bawlos uu u qoray Filibiyootajiyiinta, wuxuu leeyahay erayo culus oo dhulka nagu dhigaya: 'Waxaan bartay, xaalad kasta oo aan ku jiro, inaan ku qanco.' Bawlos wuxuu ka hadlayaa sirtaas qarsoon ee ah in la ogyahay sida loo gaajoodo iyo sida loo dhergo, sida loo helo badnaansho iyo sida loo tirsado baahi. Laakiin xaggee baa laga helaa xooggan? Wuxuu si cad u leeyahay: 'Waxaan awood u leeyahay wax kasta kan ii xoog siiya awgii.' Haa, waa xididkaas ina miiqaya ee nagu haya markii dhulku nagu culus yahay.

Waxaan maanta ka fikireynaa Benjamin Vo. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo dhex muuqdo dunidan iyadoo ay jirto caqli aan caadi ahayn. Waxaad ogtihiin sida uu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, DevOps, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas yare ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin maanta, ma doonayo inaan ka hadlo kaliya diyaaradihiisa ama xisaabtiisa heerka sarreysa. Waxaan rabaa inaan idin xasuusiyo hal daqiiqad oo muujinaysa qalbiga dhabta ah ee Ben. Xusuusnow markii uu ahaa shan iyo toban jir, ee uu u sheegay hooyadiis iyo aabbihiis inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta ku jirtay si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, lacagtiisana lama bixin sababtoo ah waxaa jiray caymis, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga rabo.

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sheekada ku saabsan in la noqdo mid lagu kalsoonaan karo arrimaha yaryar. 'Qofka lagu kalsoonaan karo arrimaha aadka u yar ayaa sidoo kale lagu kalsoonaan karaa kuwa waaweyn.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil lagu kalsoonaan karo xitaa marka uu ahaa mid yar oo daciif ah, wiil aan marnaba ilaawin inuu yiraahdo 'Good morning, Dad' subax kasta oo uu hoos u soo dego. Waxa uu ahaa wiilka dhagaysan jiray sheekooyinka khayaaliga ah ee aabbihiis hal-abuurayay, isagoo u haysta inay yihiin kuwo dhab ah, oo sidaas ku dhisay buundo adag oo jacayl ah oo aan marnaba buruburayn.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo maanta. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin, marka aad aragtaan kabaha uu bananka soo dhigay ama aad maqashaan dhawaaq u eg kii uu sameyn jiray. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen, haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

… 

Waqtiyada qaar, nolosha waxay noqotaa mid culus oo aan la qaadi karin. Laakiin bal eeg Bawlos mar kale. Wuxuu xabsiga ku jiray, isagoo dareemaya qabowga iyo go'doominta, haddana wuxuu qorayaa: 'Ilaahaygu wuxuu si buuxda idiinku siin doonaa wax kasta oo aad u baahan tihiin, si waafaqsan hodannimadiisa ammaanta leh ee ku jirta Ciise Masiix.' Haa, hodannimadaasi ma aha mid lacag ama dahab ah; waa joogitaanka joogtada ah ee Rabbiga ee nagu dhex nool markii aan daciifka nahay.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, oo xasuusanaya roller coaster-kii aad ku riyootay ama kaarka diyaaradda ee aad jeclaan lahayd inaad ku hayso kiiskaaga taleefanka, ogow in Ben uusan kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa wadnahaaga. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida qofkii bixiyay kaarkaas diyaaradda ama wadaagay riyada 'con chim airlines', jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, isagoo ka duulaya cirkaas aan xadka lahayn ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
communion: Ciise ogoow, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad joogto Sakramentka Quduuska ah ee Altariga. Waxaan kugu jeclahay wax kasta, waxaana rajeynayaa inaan naftayda ku soo dhoweeyo adiga. Ma awoodo inaan hadda jir ahaan kuu helo, laakiin fadlan ku imow xagga ruuxa qalbigayga. Waxaan ku duubayaa adiga sidii adigoo hore u joogay, waxaana isku dhiibayaa adiga oo dhan. Ha ogolaanin inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Nimcada iyo nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla joogto had iyo jeer. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: U ducaynta Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan kuwii naftooda dhiibay, inay ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiix.
U ducaynta dhammaan kuwa la ildaran murugada iyo cidlo-baxa, inay helaan qaboojin iyo rajo xagga Ilaah ka timid.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaalow, aad baan ugu farxay Rabbiga inaysan weli idinka dhammaanin welwelka aad iiga welwelsan tihiin; waad ka welwelsanayseen, laakiin fursad baynayd haysan. Keren ma leh inaan tan u leeyahay baahi awgeed, waayo waxaan bartay, xaalad kasta oo aan ku jiro, inaan ku qanco. Waan aqaan sida loo noolaado xaalad hoose, waxaan kaloo aqaan sida loo noolaado barwaaqo. Xaalad kasta iyo wax kasta waxaan bartay inaan dhergo iyo inaan gaajoodo, inaan hanto barwaaqo iyo inaan baahdo. Waxaan awood u leeyahay wax kasta kan ii xoog siiya awgii. Hase yeeshee, waxaa fiicneyd in aad ila qaybsateen dhibtayada. Idinka Filibiyootajiyiinta waa tihiin kuwa og in bilowgii injiilka, markii aan ka soo baxay Makedoniya, aysan jirin kaniisiat kale oo ila qaybsatay xisaabta bixinta iyo helitaanka mid aan idinka ahayn oo keliya. Waayo, xataa markii aan joogay Tesalonika, waxaad ii soo dirtay wixii aan u baahnaa, mana ahan hal mar oo keliya ee waa in ka badan hal mar. Ma ahan inaan doonayo hadiyadda, ee waxaan doonayaa faa'iidada idiin kordhaysa. Waxaan helay wax walba si buuxda, waana barwaaqaysanahay. Waan dhergahay, waayo waxaan ka helay Epafroditus waxaad ii soo dirtay, oo ah 'caraf udgoon,' allabari la aqbali karo oo Ilaah ka raalli ah. Ilaahaygu wuxuu si buuxda idiinku siin doonaa wax kasta oo aad u baahan tihiin, si waafaqsan hodannimadiisa ammaanta leh ee ku jirta Ciise Masiix.

readings.label: Zabuurta
readings.text: Rabbiga ka cabsada waa barakaysan yahay. Barakeysan yahay ninka ka cabsada Rabbiga, ee aad ugu raaxaysta amarkiisa. Farcankiisu wuxuu ahaan doonaa mid xoog badan dhulka; qarniga quman waa la barakayn doonaa. Wanaagsan yahay ninka naxariista leh ee wax amaahiya, ee arrimihiisa ku haga cadaalad; marna ma dhaqaaqi doono; kan xaqqa ah waxaa lagu xasuusan doonaa weligiis. Qalbigiisu waa sugan yahay; kama baqayo. Si deeqsinimo leh ayuu dadka u siiyaa; deeqsinimadiisu waxay jiri doontaa weligiis; geeskiisa waxaa lagu sarraysiin doonaa ammaano.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisa ku yiri: 'Waxaan idinku leeyahay, saaxiibo ka dhigta hantida aan xaqqa ahayn, si ay idinkugu soo dhoweeyaan guryaha weligood ah marka ay dhammaato. Qofka lagu kalsoonaan karo arrimaha aadka u yar ayaa sidoo kale lagu kalsoonaan karaa kuwa waaweyn; qofka aan daacadda ahayn arrimaha aadka u yar ayaa sidoo kale aan daacad ahayn kuwa waaweyn. Haddaba haddaanan idinku kalsoonaan karin hantida aan xaqqa ahayn, waa yuu idinku aamini doonaa hantida dhabta ah? Haddaba haddaanan idinku kalsoonaan karin waxa kan kale leeyahay, waa yuu idin siin doonaa waxa idinka ah? Ma jiro addoon u adeegi kara laba sayid; waayo mid buu neceb yahay oo kan kalena jecel yahay, ama mid buu u dhega-nugul yahay oo kan kalena dulleeyaa. Ma adeegi kartaan Ilaah iyo hanti.' Farisiyiinta oo lacagta jeclaa, markay maqleen waxaas oo dhan, way ku jeesjeceen. Markaasuu ku yiri: 'Idinku waxaad isu caddaysaan dadka hortooda, laakiin Ilaah wuu ogyahay quluubtiisa; waayo waxa dadku ku weyneeyaan waa caasinimo Ilaah hortiis.'

day: Saturday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!
